IIM: Instructional & Informational Memorandum — VDOT's numbered policy and procedure notices, issued per division (IIM-LD, IIM-S&B, IIM-TE, IIM-ED, IIM-TMPD). Revised frequently; always check the revision number.
LAP: Locally Administered Project — a project delivered by a locality rather than VDOT, governed by the LAP Manual with VDOT oversight and approval points.
LAD: Local Assistance Division — the VDOT division that supports localities, issues Letters to Local Governments, and owns the LAP Manual.
LLG: Letter to Local Governments — a numbered policy notice issued by the Local Assistance Division directly to localities.
DM: Department Memorandum — a numbered policy issuance from the Commissioner's office. DM 8-7 governs delivery of locally administered programs and projects.
L&D: Location and Design Division — roadway design, plan assembly, geometrics, drainage and CADD standards.
S&B: Structure and Bridge Division — bridge and culvert design, inspection, load rating and plan approval authority.
TMPD: Transportation and Mobility Planning Division — planning studies, access management, SSAR, traffic impact analysis.
TED: Traffic Engineering Division — merged into Traffic Operations Division (TOD) in fall 2022; existing IIM-TE numbers were retained.
TOD: Traffic Operations Division — traffic engineering, safety, work zones, signals and signing.
SYIP: Six-Year Improvement Program — the Commonwealth Transportation Board's six-year program of funded projects.
CTB: Commonwealth Transportation Board — the body that allocates funding and awards contracts for the state highway system.
SMART SCALE: Virginia's prioritization process for scoring and selecting transportation projects for funding.
SSAR: Secondary Street Acceptance Requirements (24VAC30-92) — the regulation governing acceptance of new secondary streets into the state system.
MS4: Municipal Separate Storm Sewer System — a regulated stormwater conveyance system; VDOT holds an MS4 permit and IIM-LD-242 addresses it.
VSMP: Virginia Stormwater Management Program (9VAC25-870) — the state's post-construction stormwater regulatory program.
ESC: Erosion and Sediment Control — the construction-phase program under 9VAC25-840.
BMP: Best Management Practice — a structural or non-structural stormwater treatment measure.
NEPA: National Environmental Policy Act — federal environmental review; implemented for highways through 23 CFR 771.
CE: Categorical Exclusion — the lowest tier of NEPA documentation, used for most routine projects.
ROW: Right of Way — the land interest acquired for a transportation facility; acquisition follows 49 CFR 24.
LUP: Land Use Permit — the permit required to work within VDOT right of way, governed by 24VAC30-151.
MOI: Manual of Instructions — the Materials Division's governing manual for sampling, testing and materials control.
VTM: Virginia Test Method — VDOT's own standardized material test procedures.
RDM: Road Design Manual — the primary roadway design resource for VDOT-owned or maintained projects.
R&B: Road and Bridge Standards and Specifications — the official standard drawings and contract specifications.
SPCN: Special Provision Copied Note — a project-specific modification to the standard specifications.
PE: Preliminary Engineering — the design phase of project development, and the funding category that pays for it.
CN: Construction — the construction phase of a project, and its funding category.
PCE: Project Cost Estimating — VDOT's estimating process and system.
UCI: Urban Construction Initiative — a program allowing qualifying localities to administer their own urban construction program.
DBE: Disadvantaged Business Enterprise — the federal contracting program under 49 CFR 26.
OJT: On-the-Job Training — the federal training program for construction contracts under 23 CFR 230.
TAMP: Transportation Asset Management Plan — required under 23 CFR 515 for pavements and bridges on the NHS.
NBIS: National Bridge Inspection Standards — 23 CFR 650 Subpart C, the federal bridge inspection requirements.
LRFD: Load and Resistance Factor Design — the AASHTO bridge design methodology, with VDOT modifications in IIM-S&B-80.
CRR: Corrosion Resistant Reinforcing steel — reinforcement types addressed in IIM-S&B-81.
MUTCD: Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices — the national standard for signs, signals and markings; Virginia issues a supplement.
TTC: Temporary Traffic Control — work zone traffic control, governed by the Virginia Work Area Protection Manual.
PTRS: Portable Temporary Rumble Strips — work zone warning devices addressed in IIM-TE-386.
ADA: Americans with Disabilities Act — Title II accessibility obligations, including curb ramps and pedestrian facility alterations under 28 CFR 35.151.
PROWAG: Public Right-of-Way Accessibility Guidelines — the accessibility standard for pedestrian facilities in the public right of way.
TIA: Traffic Impact Analysis — required for certain development under the Chapter 527 regulations (24VAC30-155).
AM: Access Management — the regulation of entrances and connections to highways under 24VAC30-73.
ADT: Average Daily Traffic — the traffic volume measure used throughout design and planning.
FHWA: Federal Highway Administration — the federal agency overseeing federal-aid highway projects.
VAC: Virginia Administrative Code — where Virginia's regulations live, e.g. 24VAC30-92 for the SSAR.
CFR: Code of Federal Regulations — federal regulations, e.g. 23 CFR for highways.
District: One of VDOT's nine construction districts (Bristol, Salem, Lynchburg, Richmond, Hampton Roads, Fredericksburg, Culpeper, Staunton, Northern Virginia). Many approvals are delegated to the District.
